# Pretendard Variable

This is the unmodified official webfont from `orioncactus/pretendard`.

- Source: https://github.com/orioncactus/pretendard/blob/main/packages/pretendard/dist/web/variable/woff2/PretendardVariable.woff2
- Upstream Git blob: `49c54b5152a184a243e85f7281ed338b6569987e`
- SHA-256: `9599f12fd42fc0bce1cd50b47a0c022e108d7aa64dd0d1bb0ed44f3282d900b4`

- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; full notices are in `Pretendard-LICENSE.txt`.
- The content-hashed URL is permanent. Replace with a new filename if the bytes change.

The product supplies this same-origin asset so a CSS family declaration cannot
silently stand in for verified Pretendard rendering. Native QA records the font
actually used by Chrome's `CSS.getPlatformFontsForNode` after font loading.
